channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Royal Marines fire mortars in Arctic Norway training
item.description: Royal Marines have carried out live mortar firing drills in northern Norway as part of preparations for a major NATO exercise and an expanded UK role in Arctic security. The post Royal Marines fire mortars in Arctic Norway training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Indian Air Force to help train British jet pilots
item.description: Indian Air Force instructors are set to begin training Royal Air Force fast jet pilots at RAF Valley under a new agreement that may also help ease long-running pressure on Britain's military flying training pipeline. The post Indian Air Force to help train British jet pilots first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain set to deploy aircraft carrier strike group
item.description: Keir Starmer has confirmed that the UK will deploy its Carrier Strike Group to the North Atlantic and High North regions later this year, with HMS Prince of Wales set to lead the deployment. #MSC2026 The post Britain set to deploy aircraft carrier strike group first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to send carrier north in show of force against Russia
item.description: The UK will deploy a Carrier Strike Group to the North Atlantic and High North in 2026 under Operation Firecrest, aimed at deterring Russia and protecting critical undersea infrastructure. The post UK to send carrier north in show of force against Russia first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Scottish Secretary to pursue shipbuilding deals in Indo-Pacific
item.description: The UK Government has announced that Scottish Secretary Douglas Alexander will travel to Australia, New Zealand and Singapore on a week-long trade and defence mission. The post Scottish Secretary to pursue shipbuilding deals in Indo-Pacific first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK should have more submarines, MPs told
item.description: The UK should consider significantly expanding its submarine force as undersea threats proliferate and the barriers to entry for hostile actors continue to fall, witnesses told MPs. The post UK should have more submarines, MPs told first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MPs warned Russia is way ahead in undersea warfare
item.description: Witnesses told MPs that the Russian submarine force and deep-sea directorate GUGI give Moscow a major advantage in undersea operations, with the UK described as being on the frontline due to its concentration of data cables and energy infrastructure. The post MPs warned Russia is way ahead in undersea warfare first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Starmer warns Europe must end overdependence on US
item.description: Starmer warned that European leaders must be prepared to make difficult decisions and build public consent for increased defence spending and rearmament, arguing that political hesitation could allow extremist voices to fill the vacuum. #MSC2026 The post Starmer warns Europe must end overdependence on US first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK claims significant progress on Challenger 3 export talks
item.description: The Ministry of Defence says it has said that it has made "significant progress" in exploring export opportunities linked to the Challenger 3 tank programme, but has declined to provide further detail. The post UK claims significant progress on Challenger 3 export talks first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Army has 282 on small drone training pathways
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that 282 personnel are currently participating in the British Army's centralised small Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (sUAS) training pathways. The post Army has 282 on small drone training pathways first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
